page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9a.48xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T25 processor running on the KVM hypervisor. Operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz, the instance delivers 192 dedicated vCPUs coupled with 768.0 GB of system memory. This configuration establishes a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, providing 4.0 GB of memory per core to support broad enterprise processing tasks.

Hardware architecture for the ecs.g9a.48xlarge does not include local disk storage or GPU acceleration. Persistent storage relies entirely on network-attached block devices, supported by a baseline network throughput of 96 Gbps. The instance includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, designating it for operation within secure private network topologies where external connectivity is managed via gateways.

The 192-core allocation and 96 Gbps network baseline accommodate compute-dense, horizontally scaled services without requiring GPU accelerators. Typical workloads that match this resource profile include large-scale web application deployments, distributed caching, continuous integration and build systems, data transformation pipelines, and enterprise application hosting.
